media.source: Authored vector illustration for Sortie Field Notes: a generic game controller with lit buttons and no hands, and a punched paper tape whose holes are generated from the first 348 tics (about ten seconds) of DEMO1 in the shareware Doom v1.9 DOOM1.WAD (one column per 4 tics; fire, use, forward speed and turning on separate tracks). The controller is not modelled on any real product. No game images, no third-party artwork, no image-generation model.

media.source: Original chart by Sortie Field Notes. Data: lump DEMO1 of id Software's shareware DOOM1.WAD v1.9 (MD5 f0cefca49926d00903cf57551d901abe), parsed by Field Notes using the demo format in linuxdoom-1.10 g_game.c (id-Software/DOOM commit a77dfb96cb91780ca334d0d4cfd86957558007e0): 13-byte header, then forward, sideways, turn (high byte) and button bytes per tic. Every tic is drawn; nothing is smoothed. No game was run.
